text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, positive nitrites, presence of bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are also present. No ketones or casts detected. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
